name: Speak with Coleman
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.

Coleman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the Forsaken's enemies.

You will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, it is true. I have need for your skills in combat. My means are small, but my task aids both me and the Forsaken's cause. Do it, and your reward will be twofold.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 10 to 11, 2,670 XP in all.

quests.name: Speak with Dillinger
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

quests.name: Ulag the Cleaver
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ulag the Cleaver, then speak with Deathguard Dillinger.

quests.name: Agamand Heirlooms
quests.objectiveText: Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.
